name: What should I prepare before a bathroom tile installation team arrives?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before a bathroom tile installation team arrives?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before tile installers arrive, you should clear personal items, establish access, and make key aesthetic decisions in advance. Remove all toiletries, towels, shower curtains, and freestanding decor from the bathroom and surrounding hallways. Confirm your chosen tile layout pattern, grout color, and edge trim style, such as metal Schluter profiles versus bullnose tiles. If you are replacing vanities or plumbing fixtures, verify that their rough-in dimensions match the new tile thickness. Discussing placement details like shower niche heights before work starts prevents delays and unexpected rework.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear out all personal items, confirm your layout pattern and grout color, and verify that any new plumbing rough-ins match your planned tile thickness.
